Phase 0: Core materialization gate, media primitives, execution foundation.

Acceptance Criteria:
  - Materialization gate enforcement is complete
  - Media primitive types are defined and tested
  - Execution foundation supports zero-copy path
  - MediaCore tests pass (55/55)
  - Governance validators pass or have known tracked debt

Proof:
  - Docs/proofs/p0-003-polytropos-phase0-implementation.md
  - Docs/proofs/p0-003-test-results.md

Unify under anigmad with warm subprocess pooling for parallel execution.

Acceptance Criteria:
  - anigmad subprocess pool lifecycle is implemented
  - worker lease checkout/checkin is tested
  - crashed workers are detected and recycled or retired
  - shutdown reaps child processes deterministically
  - governance validators pass

Proof:
  - Docs/proofs/p0-004-anigmad-subprocess-pooling.md

Acceptance Criteria:
  - ProcessPool<W> generic pool manager implemented
  - SubprocessWorker protocol defined
  - WorkerInfo and WorkerState tracking implemented
  - PoolConfiguration and PoolMetrics support complete
  - Per-worker-type pools functional

Proof:
  - anigma/Packages/SubprocessPooling/Sources/SubprocessManager.swift
  - anigma/Packages/SubprocessPooling/Tests/SubprocessManagerTests.swift

Acceptance Criteria:
  - HarmoniaV2CLI commands ported to AnigmaDaemon/CLI.swift
  - CLI integration preserves command intent
  - HarmoniaV2CLIKernel provides testable isolation
  - All legacy CLI functionality consolidated

Proof:
  - anigma/Packages/AnigmaDaemon/CLI.swift
  - anigma/Package.swift

Acceptance Criteria:
  - MLWorkerPool with round-robin workload balancing
  - UMABufferPool for zero-copy tensor data transfer
  - ModelCache for GPU model caching and reuse
  - Multi-GPU support with per-GPU worker pools
  - MLPoolMetrics for observability

Proof:
  - anigma/Packages/SubprocessPooling/Sources/MLWorker.swift
  - anigma/Packages/SubprocessPooling/Tests/MLWorkerPoolIntegrationTests.swift

Acceptance Criteria:
  - MCPWorkerPool for JSON-RPC communication
  - UnixDomainSocketIPC for low-latency IPC
  - Streaming MCP request handling in SubprocessManager
  - MCPPoolMetrics for pool observability
  - JSON-RPC request/response structures defined

Proof:
  - anigma/Packages/SubprocessPooling/Sources/MCPWorker.swift
  - anigma/Packages/SubprocessPooling/Sources/IPC/UnixDomainSocketIPC.swift
  - anigma/Packages/SubprocessPooling/Tests/MCPWorkerIntegrationTests.swift

Acceptance Criteria:
  - PDFSidecarWorker for isolated PDF processing
  - BenchmarkWorker for performance testing
  - On-demand spawning with macOS sandbox support
  - Per-request subprocess isolation

Proof:
  - anigma/Packages/SubprocessPooling/Sources/PDFSidecarWorker.swift
  - anigma/Packages/SubprocessPooling/Sources/BenchmarkWorker.swift
  - anigma/Packages/SubprocessPooling/Tests/Phase5OnDemandSubprocessTests.swift

Acceptance Criteria:
  - Architectural decision: AnigmaGeminiBridge eliminated
  - Unified LLM provider framework implemented (6.1)
  - All provider implementations complete (6.2-6.6)
  - Daemon HTTP endpoints for LLM routing (6.7)
  - Security and rate limiting implemented (6.8)
  - Migration and deprecation complete (6.9)
  - AnigmaGeminiBridge removed from Package.swift

Proof:
  - Docs/td/TD_PHASE6_UPDATE.md
  - anigma/Docs/LLM/Retirement/AnigmaGeminiBridge_Retirement_Summary.md
  - anigma/Docs/LLM/Migration/GeminiBridge_Migration_Guide.md
  - anigma/Packages/SubprocessPooling/Sources/LLMProviders/

Acceptance Criteria:
  - validate_tiers.py exits with code 0
  - SecurityEventsManager correctly classified as TIER_2
  - SubprocessPooling added to TIER_2
  - AnigmaDaemonCore and AnigmaDaemon added to TIER_3
  - Package.swift dependencies corrected
  - All three governance validators pass

Proof:
  - Docs/proofs/p1-validate-tiers-green-gate.md

Acceptance Criteria:
  - No 0-byte artifact files in Docs/schemas, Docs/manifests, Docs/diagrams
  - All JSON schemas parse as valid JSON
  - All YAML manifests parse as valid YAML
  - All Mermaid diagrams have valid syntax
  - All Graphviz diagrams have valid DOT syntax
  - Structurizr DSL workspace is valid
  - Proof document records validation

Proof:
  - Docs/proofs/documentation-artifacts-completion.md

After TD database reset on 2026-05-02, establish Docs/ as the durable
source of truth and TD as the local execution queue. Create bootstrap
and validation scripts to make TD reconstructible from Docs/.


Acceptance Criteria:
  - TD source-of-truth doctrine exists and is canonical
  - TD task registry exists with active lanes defined
  - Bootstrap script emits reproducible td commands from registry
  - Sync validator passes on registry and TD state
  - Proof artifact exists documenting the recovery
  - Existing architecture validators still pass
  - No runtime source changes

Remove sensitive data, large binaries, and generated artifacts from
Git history before public GitHub publication.


Acceptance Criteria:
  - Generated artifacts are removed from Git history
  - Vendored binaries with unclear provenance are excluded
  - No blobs over 100MB remain in history
  - Remote push succeeds without errors
  - Repository builds cleanly after cleanup
